4764810.desc: There’s no place like home - and yours is no home at all. Play as Rosa, a neglected child trying to escape her abusive family. Sneak out, but be ever so quiet. Mom is listening, dad is angry, and your big sister is always watching…
4764810.name: Step Lightly

4774170.desc: Aerolicious is a short and relaxing brick-breaking game about clearing a big chunk of 3,757 blocks.
4774170.name: Aerolicious

4775410.desc: Big E’s back in action! Working the farm over Summer is never easy - but everyone knows you’re the best. Do your utmost to keep the product moving, the customers happy and the law at bay, and everything’ll turn out great!
4775410.name: Jeffrey Eggstein

4782480.desc: This is a super casual little game where you can earn rewards just by playing offline. You can also listen to several nice original songs. After a busy day, relax and enjoy a moment of peace.
4782480.name: Flirting Goddesses by AFK

4790520.desc: "ELEVATOR: AVICI" is a 1st-person psychological horror with a retro, HK lo-fi aesthetic. Trapped in a decaying apartment elevator, your only link to the outside is a strange voice on the intercom claiming to be a repairman. Will you follow his commands, or find your own escape from the darkness?
4790520.name: ELEVATOR: AVICI

4790970.desc: A casual companion that lives on your Windows desktop. Strike the woodfish to earn Merit, collect skins, open chests, complete collections and crafting, and play online with up to 3 Steam friends.
4790970.name: Electronic Woodfish

4824420.desc: Idle RPG with full offline progression and multiple endgame progression systems. Choose a class and start fighting, gathering, crafting, master elements & talent trees, train mercenaries, join factions and fight world bosses with real players. No microtransactions. By idle players for idle players
4824420.name: Vespera

4834070.desc: How much can you collect before the ship goes under? How will you use what you have? Act fast and make constant choices to escape the sea or become its next victim.
4834070.name: Don't Sleep With The Fishes

4835250.desc: "Stories to Tell" Is a psychological horror game series developed by a 16 year old were each installment is based on a dream/nightmare that I, the developer, have experienced. This is a game you wouldn't want to miss...
4835250.name: [Stories to Tell] The Stoneville Incident

4836650.desc: Penguin Lifter is a game where you work as a penguin lifter. You'll work outdoors, far from civilization, surrounded by cute creatures - penguins. It's just you, the snow, and the penguins...
4836650.name: Penguin Lifter

4852580.desc: John is a detective searching for a missing colleague. He finds himself trapped in a mysterious loop where reality constantly changes. Explore eerie environments, interact with clues, and uncover the truth behind the disappearance in this third-person psychological horror experience.
4852580.name: The Lure

4860340.desc: Bring forgotten places back to life in a cozy cleaning and restoration game! Clean dirt and trash, repair damaged areas, decorate interiors with furniture, and enjoy a relaxing experience at your own pace.
4860340.name: Dream House Cleaning

4861510.desc: A slacker stick figure named Bota moves onto your desktop. An idle app where you sneak peeks between tasks as he idly mutters to himself to match the time of day and the day of the week. He won't get in your way. Sometimes he talks to you. That's the whole app.
4861510.name: Sill Sticks

4864080.desc: SSTWL - Sector Breach is a sit and survive, point-and-click survival-horror game about the characters and world created by Liam Vickers.
4864080.name: SSTWL - Sector Breach

4869070.desc: 《Delvegg》 is a desktop idle mining game. The core gameplay revolves around digging eggs, collecting pets, and building your underground mining empire.
4869070.name: Delvegg

4881550.desc: GEL RUN is a colorful obstacle-course adventure where being flexible is your greatest power.
4881550.name: GEL RUN

4914570.desc: ON&OFF is a turn-based strategy game where you manipulate pieces on a grid to trigger explosive chain reactions. Toggle pieces ON to attack, defend, and heal. Read the enemy's telegraphed intents, unleash powerful skills, and master the board to survive!
4914570.name: ON&OFF

4914600.desc: Defeated by a witch and turned into a pot! Slay strangely beautiful monster girls, pack their materials into your cramped pot, and build synergies. Stronger synergies make MSG rain faster, cutting item cooldowns. Climb the tower and reclaim your body in this inventory autobattler roguelite!
4914600.name: Pot's On!

4914610.desc: Dear Magical Girls is a story-driven defense game about an overworked magical girl protecting the Mana Stone that keeps the city running. Move the vertices to reshape your magical field. Unlock modules and enchants, and build your own strategy to survive against waves of monsters.
4914610.name: Dear Magical Girls

4918760.desc: An infuriating platformer themed around Monty Python and the Holy Grail starring Pipkin Pippa in her search for the holy grail. Climb through 5 levels to reach the end, be careful not to fall and lose all your progress!
4918760.name: Pippa of Caerbannog

4918800.desc: Explore a frozen fantasy world in an educational point-and-click adventure. Follow Flora, Freyja and Ramia through story-driven quests, learn English spelling and grammar, and face turn-based battles where words become your greatest weapon.
4918800.name: Pago Forest 2: Frozen Memories

4927490.desc: Cleaning Up The Puzzle Gallery is a cozy first-person organization simulator about cleaning up 2071 puzzle pieces scattered across a gallery of 87 famous paintings. Whether you want to relax and solve jigsaw puzzles to classical music, or min-max to get the fastest times, the gallery needs cleaning.
4927490.name: Cleaning Up The Puzzle Gallery

4935510.desc: Cellar Keeper is a cozy single-player organizing simulator where you sort 2,448 scattered bottles throughout a forgotten cellar. Return every bottle to its proper shelf, organize collections by type, unlock helpful abilities, and restore perfect order as efficiently as possible.
4935510.name: Cellar Keeper

606150.desc: Moonlighter is an Action RPG with rogue-lite elements that demonstrates two sides of the coin – revealing everyday routines of Will, an adventurous shopkeeper that secretly dreams of becoming a hero.
606150.name: Moonlighter

674750.desc: Top-down zombie shooter with tower defense elements featuring up to 4 players local and online co-op. Build your base by day, defend it by night, put your skills to the test to stay alive as long as possible! Darkness is coming. How long can YOU survive?
674750.name: Yet Another Zombie Defense HD

738520.desc: Survive in outer space! Together with your immortal chicken, discover the truth behind your sudden spaceship crash. Craft tools, pilot vehicles, and even control space stations to survive and explore the wreckage.
738520.name: Breathedge

802890.desc: Playtime's over. Time for despair. Experience the definitive version of a masterpiece in the Muv-Luv trilogy's thrilling conclusion. Note: therapy not included.
802890.name: Muv-Luv Alternative

865360.desc: As we explore these frozen wastes, misfortune strikes once again. Through the fierce blizzard, a flare lights the sky, followed by a cry for help over the radio - broken, dying... No one else can come to their rescue. Can we make it back - together?
865360.name: We Were Here Together

896250.desc: Enter the war-torn world of Veá, where sci-fi and fantasy collide in Liquidation, an immersive RTS. Lead your armies and harness powerful abilities in a high-stakes battle for Quenrium, the mysterious substance that holds Veá’s fate.
896250.name: Liquidation

931060.desc: Wake up inside the nightmare world you created in this standalone, hand-drawn dark fantasy point-and-click adventure with psychological horror elements. Explore islands, solve puzzles, and make morally ambiguous choices that lead to multiple endings. Inspired by H.R. Giger and Zdzisław Beksiński.
931060.name: Tormentum II

940140.desc: As a threat from beyond looms over the solar system, take control of the AETHER prototype in this rhythmic and tactical space shooter - fusing classic arcade-style action with stunning 3D environments and an engaging sci-fi story.
940140.name: Project AETHER: First Contact
